description:
Lost Survival Knowledge documents the self-reliance skills of early American homesteads, trail camps, and backcountry farms — fire, food, water, shelter, weather, and medicine as our great-grandparents actually practiced them.

What a settler family knew wasn't trivia. It was the difference between a hard winter and a fatal one. Every episode is built from period manuals, homestead ledgers, county histories, and firsthand accounts from the 1700s and 1800s, and goes past the surface-level "life hack" version of history to explain why a method worked and why it disappeared.

Narrated by Joe. No synthetic or AI-generated voices.

New episodes weekly. 🪓🔥
